author: marlon-chaviano
name: monorepo-rails-react
title: Rails API + React in one repo
description: A Rails 8 API and a React + Vite frontend in the same repo: Rails productivity on the backend and a modern SPA in front.

base.command: command -v rails >/dev/null || { echo 'Rails is required: gem install rails' >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir {{name}} && cd {{name}} && rails new backend --api --skip-git --skip-kamal --skip-thruster --quiet && npx -y create-vite@latest frontend --template react-ts --no-interactive

verify.command: cd backend && bin/rails db:prepare && bin/rails test && cd ../frontend && npm run build

setupTasks: CORS: uncomment `rack-cors` in `backend/Gemfile` and `config/initializers/cors.rb` with the frontend's origin when the web app calls the API from another domain.
instructions:
## How to work here

- `backend/` is Rails in API mode (start with `cd backend && bin/rails server`) and `frontend/` is React + Vite (`cd frontend && npm run dev`).
- Generate API resources with `bin/rails g scaffold <Model> field:type`; they respond with JSON.
- Before finishing: `bin/rails test` in `backend/` and `npm run build` in `frontend/`.
- Each app lives in its own folder with its own dependencies; don't mix code from one into another.
- Whatever backend and frontend share (types, API contracts) is defined in one place and documented.
